# Pypacity

Pypacity is a Python library for **Dynamic Thermal Rating**.


```{warning}
This project is under heavy development. Be carefull my friends!
```

## Installation

To install the software:

```{code-block}
---
emphasize-lines: 1
------
$ pip install pypacity
```
